Hæc autem descripsi ex ipso contextu divinarum Scripturarum duplici de causa; una ut tanquam digito, & in speculo Principi, & Rectori Ecclesiarum conspiciantur, ut edificat, & a se dirigendos doceat divina præcepta, quæ per Prophetas, & Apostolos Spiritu prolata sunt. Altera, ut magis, quam Canones Patrum, hæc oporteat cordis tabulis obsignari, & custodiri. Subdit præterea, illa Scripturarum eloquia, & Patrum dicta, ut pupillam oculi custodiri oportere: [illegible, ~12 letters] diri oportere: [illegible, ~10 letters]

page.notes: The Syriac lines are illegible to me; the letter counts are estimates. The Syriac quotation after "custodiri oportere:" is set in the Latin line and continues below it. "edificat" is read from "edifcat" and marked as doubtful in the text. Original spelling kept elsewhere, with u/v and i/j normalised. Long s taken as plain s.
